3501.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — TeamPCP's Mini Shai-Hulud Is Back: A Self-Spreading Supply Chain Attack Compromi
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("bun.exe", "npm-cli.js", "install.js", "opensearch_init.js", "tanstack_runner.js", "router_init.js", "payload_5.py", "payload_1.sh", "token-monitor.sh", "router_runtime.js", "node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token", "/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml", "/var/lib/docker/containers/", "/Library/LaunchAgents/", "/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.gh-token-monitor.plist", "/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("bun.exe", "npm-cli.js", "install.js", "opensearch_init.js", "tanstack_runner.js", "router_init.js", "payload_5.py", "payload_1.sh", "token-monitor.sh", "router_runtime.js", "node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

``` Article-specific bespoke detection — TeamPCP's Mini Shai-Hulud Is Back: A Self-Spreading Supply Chain Attack Compromi ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("bun.exe","npm-cli.js","install.js","opensearch_init.js","tanstack_runner.js","router_init.js","payload_5.py","payload_1.sh","token-monitor.sh","router_runtime.js","node.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,

    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

let CampaignHosts = dynamic(["seed1.getsession.org","filev2.getsession.org","api.masscan.cloud"]);
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where RemoteUrl has_any (CampaignHosts) or tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host) in~ (CampaignHosts)
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountUpn=InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, Indicator=coalesce(RemoteUrl, RemoteIP), Source="network", InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName;
let EvHits = DeviceEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where ActionType in ("DnsQueryResponse","ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionFailed","NetworkConnectionEvents")
  | where RemoteUrl has_any (CampaignHosts) or AdditionalFields has_any (CampaignHosts)
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountUpn=InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, Indicator=coalesce(RemoteUrl, tostring(AdditionalFields)), Source="device-event", InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentFileName=tostring(parse_json(""));
NetHits
| union EvHits
| order by Timestamp desc
3502.sent:
let CampaignHosts = dynamic(["seed1.getsession.org","filev2.getsession.org","api.masscan.cloud"]);
let DnsHits = DnsEvents
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where Name has_any (CampaignHosts)
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, Indicator=Name, Source="DnsEvents";
let AsimDns = ImDnsActivity
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where DnsQuery has_any (CampaignHosts)
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, ClientIP=SrcIpAddr, Indicator=DnsQuery, Source="ImDnsActivity";
let ProxyHits = CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where DestinationHostName has_any (CampaignHosts) or RequestURL has_any (CampaignHosts)
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=SourceHostName, ClientIP=SourceIP, Indicator=coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL), Source="Proxy/CEF";
let WebHits = ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where HttpHostName has_any (CampaignHosts) or Url has_any (CampaignHosts)
  | project TimeGenerated, Computer=DvcHostname, ClientIP=SrcIpAddr, Indicator=coalesce(HttpHostName, Url), Source="ImWebSession";
DnsHits | union AsimDns, ProxyHits, WebHits
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Hits=count() by Computer, ClientIP, Indicator, Source
| order by LastSeen desc

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("kube.py", "pgmon.py", "proxy.sh", "pcpcat.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,

title: WerFaultSecure.exe Spawned By Unusual Parent (EDR-Freeze Technique)
id: 4f6c2a1b-3d5e-4c8a-9f2b-7e1c4d6f8a90
status: experimental
description: Detects WerFaultSecure.exe being spawned by a parent process that is not part of the normal Windows Error Reporting chain. EDR-Freeze abuses the PPL-protected WerFaultSecure.exe to call MiniDumpWriteDump against an EDR/AV process, suspending its threads, then suspends WerFaultSecure itself so the threads are never resumed. Highlighted by ESET as a rapidly-adopted driverless EDR killer.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/edr-killers-explained-beyond-the-drivers/
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-edr-freeze-tool-uses-windows-wer-to-suspend-security-software/
  - https://www.picussecurity.com/resource/blog/edr-freeze-the-user-mode-attack-that-puts-security-into-a-coma
  - https://binarydefense.com/resources/blog/dont-freeze-me-out-bro-arc-labs-technical-analysis-of-edr-freeze
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/threats/malware-encyclopedia-description?Name=Behavior:Win32/EDRFreeze.A
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/03
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1055
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\WerFaultSecure.exe'
  filter_legit_parents:

      - '\wermgr.exe'
      - '\WerFault.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
      - '\smss.exe'
      - '\csrss.exe'
